channel.title: TheGapBrief · Side Reports
channel.description: Detailed one-off research reports from TheGapBrief.

item.title: Side Report · October 27, 2026: Should Rich Buy a Kenworth Truck and Trailer? Costs, Pay and King County Work in the Pipeline
item.description: Used WA Kenworth T880s list at $42,500–$115,000 against $318,500 (pre-FET) new; used pups run $11K–$16K. King County public-works truck-and-trailer pay is $86.95/hr, and Seattle–Tacoma private rates are quoted at $130–$250/hr. New-venture insurance runs $14K–$20K+. Covers financing, WA permits, a labeled break-even illustration (~600 billed hours a year), the Sound Transit/WSDOT/King County pipeline and how a one-truck hauler gets on as a sub.

item.title: Side Report · October 27, 2026: A Coin Run by a Bot Team: Tokenomics, Holder Voting, the Cheapest Launch Path and Hot Crypto Markets
item.description: Launching costs only gas on pump.fun, Clanker or Zora; reported CEX entry runs from $20K–$75K (MEXC) to $500K–$2M+ (Binance). Proposes a 20% bot-compute treasury funded first by trading fees, quadratic Snapshot votes for features, seven original ideas, the hottest markets (record prediction-market volume, RWA, the AI-agent shakeout) and plain-language SEC/Washington risks.

item.title: Side Report · October 22, 2026: Letting an AI Agent Post to X, Instagram and TikTok: Tools, Prices and a Setup for Every OMI Brand
item.description: Compares 15 options, from Zernio (formerly Late), Blotato, Postiz, Ayrshare and Buffer to Hootsuite, Sprout and the native APIs, on X/IG/TikTok support, MCP/API access, multi-brand support and stated prices. Top pick: Zernio's hosted MCP at $108/mo for 30 accounts plus X API usage, with Higgsfield for reviewed TikTok drops.

item.title: Side Report · October 20, 2026: An AI Course for Kids Under 14: Market, Competitors, Ideas, Needs and Costs
item.description: Kids already use AI widely (86% of 9–17s per Common Sense), but free school curricula own basic literacy and paid live AI classes cluster at grade 6+ with Python. The opening is a safety-first, parent-in-the-loop, project-based course for ages 10–13. Includes competitor pricing, the amended COPPA rule, California's new chatbot laws, needs, costs and a pilot plan.

item.title: Side Report · October 13, 2026: AI Influencer Trends, Sep–Oct 2026: What CharacterGuard Ads Can Ride
item.description: Uncanny signature-look characters like Jean Philanthrope and Charles Robinson took off in weeks on Higgsfield-style motion transfer, and copycats followed within days. This report covers niches, hooks, tools, the fastest-growing accounts (sourced figures only), the stolen-face debate, 5 trends to ride and 3 CharacterGuard ad ideas.

item.title: Side Report · October 12, 2026: OMI Portfolio Review: Wash Wizardz, Get UI Now, DeepReach, FlirtFee and Fetch
item.description: Site-by-site fixes for the Open Mind Innovations companies, from unbacked trust claims and 8–11 MB pages to missing legal pages and a public investor form, plus bot-team plans for FlirtFee, DeepReach and Get UI Now.

item.title: Side Report · October 11, 2026: Pre-Flight for Vibe Coders: An App Store Rejection Scanner and 5 Sibling Ideas
item.description: Apple rejected 2.09M of 9.1M submissions in 2025, but pre-submission checkers are already crowded at $2.99–$199. The opening is a scanner built for vibe coders that checks the web wrapper, the backend and AI consent together. Five sibling ideas are ranked alongside it.

item.title: Side Report · October 10, 2026: 15 Low-Barrier Creative Aftermarket Opportunities for Optimus
item.description: Optimus is being built but not sold. These are 15 fun, low-capital aftermarket ideas (costumes, shells, decals, booths, wranglers), split into ones you can start now on robots you can rent today and ones that wait for robots in homes.

item.title: Side Report · October 10, 2026: 10 Micro-SaaS & Low-Maintenance Niche Opportunities
item.description: Ten single-purpose services built on the CharacterGuard pattern (free check, one-time kit, cheap watch), ranked on margin, maintenance, speed, and cited demand. SMS registration readiness and inbox-authentication fixes lead.
